name: pump_curve_similarity
title: Centrifugal pump from manufacturer curves and similarity laws
summary: Pump sized from catalogue characteristic curves (flow rate, head, isentropic efficiency, required NPSH at a rated speed) and scaled to any speed with the affinity laws; the three operating modes of the original component (P_N: flow rate from pressures and speed, P_M: speed from pressures and flow rate, M_N: discharge pressure from flow rate and speed) are shipped as three files. Translation of the LaboThapPy component PumpCurveSimilarity.

verification.summary: Adapted from the original (re-check 2026-11-02): the pinned M_N branch read eta_is and NPSH_r at the actual flow instead of the similar point; adapted to the corrected affinity laws of the upstream fix (branch Elise, 8514bf89) and verified against it: max 4.80e-10 at 2500/4000 rpm, 1.24e-08 out of range at 1450 rpm; default point unchanged (1.13e-09 vs the pinned source re-run on 2026-10-08).
verification.reference: LaboThapPy component PumpCurveSimilarity, branch origin/Elise commit 8514bf89 (pinned f03f7f47) re-run in a throw-away venv (Python 3.12, CoolProp 8.0.0, SciPy 1.18) in modes P_N, P_M and M_N; affinity-law self-check; cross-mode consistency at 2500 rpm (P_M recovers N_rot from the adapted M_N discharge pressure to 3e-10)
verification.notes: Adaptation of 2026-11-02 (card C-481, branch origin/Elise): only solve_MN changed upstream; the pinned source evaluated eta_is and NPSH_r at the actual flow rate and left NPSH_r un-scaled (as if the pump ran at rated speed); physics check (affinity laws): efficiency is a property of the similar point, eta(Q) = eta_rated(Q*N_rated/N), NPSH_r = (N/N_rated)^2 * NPSHr_rated(Q*N_rated/N). Adapted equations: eta_is, NPSH_r, V_dot_flag of pump_curve_similarity_mode_MN.eescode (marked ADAPTED). Comparison: at the default point (N_rot = N_rot_rated = 2900 rpm) pinned and fixed agree exactly and the three .sol baselines are unchanged (diff of the new mode_MN solution: empty); off-rated (2500, 3500, 4000 rpm) the pinned source returns the rated-flow efficiency 0.8628 and the unscaled NPSH_r 2.4517 m where the corrected physics gives 0.8588/0.8210/0.7772 and 2.944/2.719/3.268 m (fixed W_dot_shaft 2.7292/6.8257/9.6373 MW, pinned 2.7166/6.4949/8.6811 MW). The 2026-10-08 verification numbers (1.13e-09 in the three modes against the pinned f03f7f47 component in plain HEOS, 7.2e-03 against its default BICUBIC&HEOS backend) still hold at the default point. CS-GAP-INTERP-EXTRAP is closed: CoolSolve INTERPOLATE extrapolates linearly like scipy interp1d (checked: N = 1450 rpm, eq. flow 2467.4 m3/h outside the curves, max 1.24e-08).
